class.name: SteamLeaderboardEntry
class.brief_description: One detached score in a Steam leaderboard page.

method.name: get_details
method.description: Game-defined details copied from the score entry, with at most 64 signed 32-bit integers. Editing a returned packed array leaves the entry unchanged.

method.name: get_rank
method.description: One-based position on the global board.

method.name: get_score
method.description: Raw signed 32-bit score widened to a Godot integer. Interpret it using the board's configured units.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Full decimal SteamID64 of the player who owns this score.

method.name: get_ugc_handle
method.description: Decimal shared-file handle for a replay attachment. An empty string means there is no attachment.
